family.description: ParD-like antitoxin is a family of archaeal and bacterial proteins of a type II bacterial toxin-antitoxin system. Many of the cognate toxins for these molecules fall into family ParE-like_toxin, [pfam:PF15781]. Gene-pairs are expressed from the same operon, the toxin of the pair being expressed first, eg, for UniProtKB:Q3AQ93 and UniProtKB:Q3AQ94.
family.name: ParD-like antitoxin of type II bacterial toxin-antitoxin system
